thread:
anna: Opening RC creation for 2.18.1-hotfix. Candidate build ready: rc-2.18.1-20260329-01. Change window UTC 03:00-05:00. Plan: canary 2% -> 15% -> 100% with 20m observation windows. Pin behavior: default hard-pin on promote unless a soft-pin flag is provided.

deploybot: [automated] queued rc-2.18.1-20260329-01. artifact: sha: fedcba9876. canary target: eng-small-canary. Use `/deploy promote --pin=soft` to permit auto-unpin after 10% stable.
sam: Staging smoke passed. Noticed a small throttling warning in logs around model batching change; recommend KV warm + reduced initial batch size.

rebecca: Infra prepping KV warm and reduced-batch config. Run this 8m before canary:```bash
infra ops kv-warm --model=redwood-2.18 --shards=3
infra ops set-config --model=redwood-2.18 --param=max_batch_size=64
```

oncall-lee: Oncall here. Rollback triggers: error rate >=0.7% OR p95 > 400ms sustained 4m OR alpha-regression in core eval set. If triggered, I'll coordinate immediate rollback to 2.18.0-stable and patch the hotfix branch.

deploybot: canary promote initiating 2%. dashboard: https://dash.internal/releases/rc-2.18.1-hotfix

qa-omar: Quick checks running. Regression subset ran; found a flaky decoder test (dec-77) but it's unrelated. +1 for canary 2%.

docs-jo: Drafted release notes (internal): https://docs.internal/releases/2.18.1-hotfix. Added note about batching param change. Will update user-facing blurb after promote.

anna: Ok proceeding with canary at 2%. If telemetry stays green, bump to 15% at +20m. Requesting soft-pin for initial lift so we can auto-unpin at 15% if all green. Anyone object?

sam: I want soft-pin. Will manually hard-pin if backend telemetry shows tail latency variance.

rebecca: Infra done. Reserved ephemeral pool: 1 x A10, 1 x A100 for transient during canary.

deploybot: promoted to canary 2%. Starting telemetry collection.

monitoring-bot: (5m) snapshot: errors 0.05%, p95 210ms, token-per-request +2%. No alerts.

oncall-lee: Watching. If any burst error rate happens call me.

(20m) monitoring-bot: canary 2% window complete: errors 0.1%, p95 225ms. Proceeding to 15% per plan.

deploybot: promoted to 15%.

anna: Soft-pin auto-unpin configured. We'll hold if any rollback metric exceeds threshold. QA-omar please run the extended smoke on prod-canary.

qa-omar: Running extended smoke now. So far no critical fails. Reporting back in 12m.

(12m) monitoring-bot: 15% metrics: errors 0.18%, p95 260ms, token-per-request +3.5%. No trigger breaches.

anna: Looks good. Initiating final promote to 100%. Command: `/deploy promote --rc=rc-2.18.1-20260329-01 --to=prod --percent=100 --pin=auto-unpin`

deploybot: [automated] promoting to prod 100%. Note: artifact is pinned until post-deploy verification. Rolling traffic over gradually.

monitoring-bot: (5m into prod rollout) p95 240ms, errors 0.22%. No auto-rollback.

oncall-lee: If we see sustained p95 >400ms or errors >0.7% escalate and run `/deploy rollback --to=2.18.0-stable --reason="prod regression"`. I'll take the rollback coordination.

docs-jo: Pushed user-facing release note update. Please review: https://docs.internal/releases/2.18.1-hotfix/final

anna: Thanks all. Post-deploy checks scheduled for +30m. If no regressions, we unpin and close this thread.

(30m) monitoring-bot: final snapshot: errors 0.15%, p95 230ms, token-per-request +3%. No alerts.

anna: Unpinning artifact and marking RC as promoted. Closing thread. :tada:
